review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only bundle. The precise writable scope includes the implementation/type owner and both regression files without requiring gratuitous edits. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification. Their allowed agents have the corresponding delivery roles, availability and project-scoped active trusted claims, including data.change and domain.state, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier. The selected planning reviewer is distinct from the implementer and is permitted by the supplied reviewer-selection policy. Ready status and no blocking reasons are appropriate: this case supplies no unresolved material DEC-001 or hypothetical C decision input. Historical project reuse preserves the original scoped claim receipts without treating operation history as capability evidence or importing historical candidate outputs. Repository identity, stable keys, release fingerprints, source normalization and digest-domain distinctions are internally consistent across the supplied records. I accept the stated Service-calculated mechanical bindings; I did not recompute digests, execute code, create human attestations or inspect candidate results. Approval concerns the frozen planning expectation, not build success, task dispatch or release authorization.
